descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: double tap on In Today.

Suggestion B30 · known · not counted as a bug (was S2): Our own extended check (not stated in the UAT or a ticket AC): No AC/UAT line covers a double tap; nearest TFA-92587 AC 1 (single taps work)

A quick double tap on In Today loses one tap; the resident ends up off today's list

Tickets: TFA-92587 AC2 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S16 Double tap on the In Today toggle: the toggle ends where two taps put it, and the dashboard agrees

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents (UAT TC-09; TFA-92598 AC 4; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; resident In Today

When On All Residents, double-click the resident's In Today toggle with one browser_click call using doubleClick: true, then open the dashboard

Then Two taps are two toggles, so the resident ends In Today: the toggle reads 'In Today' (not '+ Today') and the dashboard counts the resident (Total 1). No tap is lost

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92587 AC 1 ('working In Today / + Today toggle'). List checkpoint: mustContain the resident and 'In Today', mustNotContain '+ Today'. This reads the resident's own toggle in the AC 1 wording; with one resident on the account, no other '+ Today' shows on All Residents. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 ready for qa

A quick double tap on a resident's In Today toggle loses one tap, so the resident ends up off today's list when the two taps should have left them on it.

Evidence: allure-results/d0836fed…: ledger #56 (U56, checked). A double tap on 'In Today ✓' leaves inTodaysSession=false and the button flips back to '+ Today': one tap is lost. Dev report §2 #8 (TFA-92587 AC 2, ready for qa). The dashboard still counting the resident is the S04a root.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S16

Detail:

Dev (, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts + agent unit U56. Judged 1/4. Known B30, still on dev. A double-click on Hal's 'In Today ✓' loses one tap: the toggle ends on '+ Today', the stored inTodaysSession is false, and the dashboard no longer lists Hal. Toggle, server and dashboard agree with each other (the dashboard is not stale; the tap is lost in the list's toggle). Agent unit U56 (oracle.mjs, one browser_click with doubleClick: true) on the same build: Fail, the same lost tap ('+ Today', inTodaysSession false, dashboard Total 0, 'No residents on today's visit list.').

Product issue: A physician who double-taps 'In Today ✓' sees the resident drop off Today's Visits and the dashboard (one tap lost).

Known gap (known): true
